title: Pastel Liminal Dreamcore turned into a video game 🕹🎮
author: JayB_Official
selftext:
I turned that Pastel liminal dreamcore vibe into a game 🎮😌

Claude x Astra directed by PHÆS. 

My girlfriend said it looks like barbie😂😭😭😭😭😭😭

replies.author: JayB_Official
replies.body:
Hahah i did drop this with zero explanation😂😭

So its based alot around the beauty and surrealism of the world; theirs 5 story sequences; and radiant quest between, such as finding a letter left on a table in a house that sits in the middle of a meadow by itself and the letter talks about missing somewhere and then explains that location. Your goal is to go find it, take a picture and bring back the post card. Youll never meet who left it; but if you come back after doing this your post card will be gone and a thank you letter left in its place (theirs more than just this)
You also have mallow, your stingray mount that can lift you above the clouds for areas where the ground decides to leave the chat😂
The train takes you off into the endless distance with repeated stations every so often and a schedule. 
You unlock a magic door that takes you to your permanent and upgradable player house after you complete 3 quests. Any types of quests. 
So on and so forth
